explication: Ghost is a professional publishing platform and headless CMS. In the admin workflow, an editor creates or updates a post, the editor session/save engine prepares and dispatches saves, and the API framework validates, serializes, checks permissions, and runs the configured query. Publishing, analytics, automations, comments, and member management are substantial product areas visible in the repository tree. The sampled backend pipeline supports its stage sequence; most feature-specific backend wiring was not sampled, so those branches are shown without speculative links.
